grammar.pattern: 从 + 时间 / 处所 + 起
grammar.purpose: Mark the beginning of an interval
grammar.explanation: 从下周起 sets next week as the starting point, not the end. 从这里起 can mark a starting location. A later duration or endpoint must be stated separately. 从…起 does not assert that a plan has already begun.

examples.py: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , měi zhōu liàn liǎng cì .
examples.en: Starting next week, practise twice a week.

examples.zh: 从今天起，先记录实际练习时间。
examples.py: cóng jīn tiān qǐ , xiān jì lù shí jì liàn xí shí jiān .
examples.en: Starting today, record actual practice time first.

examples.py: cóng zhè lǐ qǐ , yán zhè tiáo lù zǒu .

commonMistakes.wrong: 从下周起，就是下周结束。
commonMistakes.right: 从下周起，表示下周开始。
commonMistakes.why: 起 marks the beginning, not an endpoint.

grammar.pattern: 结束事件 + 时量 + 了
grammar.purpose: Measure elapsed time since an event ended
grammar.explanation: 她离开这里三天了 measures three days since departure; 电影结束十分钟了 measures ten minutes since the end. In contrast 她走了三天 can describe three days spent travelling. Identify the event’s end and the current reference point; a time amount alone does not decide continued action versus elapsed time.

examples.py: tā lí kāi zhè lǐ sān tiān le .
examples.en: It has been three days since she left here.

examples.py: diàn yǐng jié shù shí fēn zhōng le .
examples.en: The film ended ten minutes ago.

examples.zh: 她下课半小时了，还在门口等。
examples.py: tā xià kè bàn xiǎo shí le , hái zài mén kǒu děng .
examples.en: Class ended for her half an hour ago; she is still waiting at the doorway.

commonMistakes.wrong: 电影结束十分钟了，就是电影放了十分钟。
commonMistakes.right: 电影结束十分钟了，指结束以后过了十分钟。
commonMistakes.why: Elapsed time after ending differs from the duration of the screening.

dialogue.title: Starting, waiting and finishing
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find what starts later and what has already ended.

lines.zh: 从下周起，这门初级课程每周上两次。
lines.py: cóng xià zhōu qǐ , zhè mén chū jí kè chéng měi zhōu shàng liǎng cì .
lines.en: Starting next week, this elementary course meets twice a week.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是初步安排吗？几点开始？
lines.py: shì chū bù ān pái ma ? jǐ diǎn kāi shǐ ?
lines.en: Is this a preliminary arrangement? When does it start?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对，时间还要确认。你已经到达了吗？
lines.py: duì , shí jiān hái yào què rèn . nǐ yǐ jīng dào dá le ma ?
lines.en: Yes; the time still needs confirmation. Have you arrived?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我接近教室了，赶时间也先看地址。
lines.py: wǒ jiē jìn jiào shì le , gǎn shí jiān yě xiān kàn dì zhǐ .
lines.en: I am near the classroom; even in a hurry I check the address.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 上一节下课半小时了，老师还在等待。
lines.py: shàng yī jié xià kè bàn xiǎo shí le , lǎo shī hái zài děng dài .
lines.en: The previous class ended half an hour ago; the teacher is still waiting.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我赶到了，先慢慢看通知，不把着急当准备好。
lines.py: wǒ gǎn dào le , xiān màn màn kàn tōng zhī , bù bǎ zháo jí dāng zhǔn bèi hǎo .
lines.en: I arrived in time; read the notice slowly first rather than treating urgency as readiness.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 录音可以自己复习，分享要另问。
lines.py: lù yīn kě yǐ zì jǐ fù xí , fēn xiǎng yào lìng wèn .
lines.en: The recording can be used for personal review; ask separately about sharing.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，记录开始和结束的时刻，纪录别写成正式成绩。
lines.py: hǎo , jì lù kāi shǐ hé jié shù de shí kè , jì lù bié xiě chéng zhèng shì chéng jì .
lines.en: Okay; record start and end times, and do not label the record an official result.
lines.speaker: b

reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.

lines.zh: 初到这里，她先找教室；初中时写日记的习惯后来帮助她做记录。
lines.py: chū dào zhè lǐ , tā xiān zhǎo jiào shì ; chū zhōng shí xiě rì jì de xí guàn hòu lái bāng zhù tā zuò jì lù .
lines.en: On first arriving she found the classroom; her junior-school diary habit later helped her keep records.

lines.zh: 从下周起开初级课程，是初步计划，后年的安排还没定。
lines.py: cóng xià zhōu qǐ kāi chū jí kè chéng , shì chū bù jì huà , hòu nián de ān pái hái méi dìng .
lines.en: The elementary course starting next week is a preliminary plan; arrangements for the year after next are undecided.

lines.zh: 开课以来的练习都有日期，但开始了不代表已经学会。
lines.py: kāi kè yǐ lái de liàn xí dōu yǒu rì qī , dàn kāi shǐ le bù dài biǎo yǐ jīng xué huì .
lines.en: Practice since opening is dated, but starting does not mean already having learned it.

lines.zh: 接近上课时间，等待将近十分钟后，她终于到达并赶到了最后一次说明。
lines.py: jiē jìn shàng kè shí jiān , děng dài jiāng jìn shí fēn zhōng hòu , tā zhōng yú dào dá bìng gǎn dào le zuì hòu yī cì shuō míng .
lines.en: Near class time, after waiting almost ten minutes, she arrived in time for the final explanation.

lines.zh: 上课前后分别记录；下课半小时了，指下课到现在的间隔。
lines.py: shàng kè qián hòu fēn bié jì lù ; xià kè bàn xiǎo shí le , zhǐ xià kè dào xiàn zài de jiàn gé .
lines.en: Record before and after class separately; “class ended half an hour ago” measures the interval until now.

lines.zh: 她慢慢核对时刻，录自己的声音，录音只供个人复习，练习纪录不冒充正式成绩。
lines.py: tā màn màn hé duì shí kè , lù zì jǐ de shēng yīn , lù yīn zhǐ gōng gè rén fù xí , liàn xí jì lù bù mào chōng zhèng shì chéng jì .
lines.en: She slowly checks times, records her voice and uses the audio personally; practice records are not official results.

lines.zh: 她订阅一期杂志，每期日期另查；农历初一也不等于公历一号。
lines.py: tā dìng yuè yī qī zá zhì , měi qī rì qī lìng chá ; nóng lì chū yī yě bù děng yú gōng lì yī hào .
lines.en: She subscribes to one magazine issue and checks each issue’s date separately; lunar day one differs from Gregorian day one.

lines.zh: 截至今天仍然只有初步安排，等待时能问进展，不能把建议当确认。
lines.py: jié zhì jīn tiān réng rán zhǐ yǒu chū bù ān pái , děng dài shí néng wèn jìn zhǎn , bù néng bǎ jiàn yì dāng què rèn .
lines.en: As of today there is still only a preliminary plan; ask for progress while waiting rather than treat suggestions as confirmation.

choices: To avoid treating start, duration and elapsed time as the same
